prompt:
A 3-minute instrumental track. Instrumental only, no vocals, no lyrics.
Genre: modern cinematic trap / chill electronic, steady and flowing, made as background for knowledge and science videos. The energy stays high and even the whole way: no quiet breakdowns, no long silences, the beat almost never stops.
Tempo: exactly 112 BPM, 4/4, never changes. Key: F minor, the whole song stays in F minor.
Harmony: one four-bar loop all song long: Fm | Fm | Db | Eb, one chord per bar; the Db bar is slightly softer, like a breath. In the final section the loop is Fm | Gb | Db | Eb.
Instruments: a bright plucked synth carries the main melody, a felt piano answers it and doubles it in the bigger sections, warm synth pad, deep 808 sub bass on the roots, trap drum kit: kick on beat 1 and beat 3 with a pickup on the "and" of 1, crisp clap on beats 2 and 4, steady 16th-note hi-hats with short triplet rolls every 4 bars, soft risers into each section. Original melody in short 2-bar phrases that repeat and are easy to remember.

[0:00 - 0:11] Intro: a bright plucked synth melody with pad, 808 and a light version of the beat already playing at medium volume.
[0:11 - 0:17] Pre-drop: 3 bars where the drums drop out, a bright plucked synth and pad continue, a riser builds.
[0:17 - 1:24] Main: full beat drops in on the downbeat, a bright plucked synth melody, a felt piano answers, steady and catchy.
[1:24 - 1:44] Breather: the beat keeps going at almost the same volume, the melody instruments get softer and darker; the last bar is a short stop.
[1:44 - 2:18] Main again: full beat, a bright plucked synth and a felt piano together.
[2:18 - 2:48] Final peak: fuller and warmer, heavier 808 and wide low pads, a bright plucked synth and a felt piano in octaves, slightly louder but not brighter.
[2:48 - 3:02] Ending: the beat thins, a bright plucked synth plays the motif once more, ends on F minor.

description.en: Take E2, sped up to 111.6 BPM. Steady trap groove for explainers: kick and clap backbeat, 16th hi-hats with rolls, 808 sub, a four-bar minor loop, section changes every 8-16 bars.
description.zh: E2 版，提速到 111.6 BPM。为知识科普视频做的稳定 Trap 律动：底鼓加二四拍拍手、16 分音符踩镲和滚奏、808 低音、四小节小调循环，每 8 到 16 小节换一层。

metadataBasis: description, style, tempo, moods and energy are prompt intent; tempo of edited takes measured by beat-grid fit; duration is measured; no automated audio review
